title: Community Dance Leadership
learning_focus: Leading rhythmic activities and dances; movement competence, participation, inclusion, safety, and One Health campaign synthesis.
story_premise: The Guardians must lead a community movement event that also communicates prevention and environmental-health messages.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Leading rhythmic activities and dances; movement competence, participation, inclusion, safety, and One Health campaign synthesis.

areas.title: Warm-Up Circle
areas.story: Lead safe progressive movement. Teach a short pattern with optional intensity levels and light apparatus where appropriate.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: A health or safety concern is affecting Warm-Up Circle.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Observe the signs, think about Leading rhythmic activities and dances, then apply the safest healthy action.

learning_clues: Health focus: Leading rhythmic activities and dances.
Observe signs, context, and available trusted support before acting.

questions.prompt: What is the healthiest first response in Warm-Up Circle?

options.text: pause, observe the situation, and choose a safe action related to Leading rhythmic activities and dances
Ignore the signs and continue the unsafe behavior.
Copy another person without checking the situation.
Hide the problem and avoid trusted help.

questions.first_wrong_hint: Use the visible health clues before deciding.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: The safe first step is to pause, observe the situation, and choose a safe action related to Leading rhythmic activities and dances.
questions.correct_feedback: The safe first step is to pause, observe the situation, and choose a safe action related to Leading rhythmic activities and dances.

questions.prompt: Health clues should be observed before the learner chooses an action.

options.text: True
False

questions.first_wrong_hint: Think about why the NPC, environment, or body signal is shown.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: The statement is true: the clues provide the reason for the healthy or safe choice.
questions.correct_feedback: The statement is true: the clues provide the reason for the healthy or safe choice.

questions.prompt: Select the two actions that support a safe and healthy decision.

options.text: Use the observed clues.
Choose a safe action or ask a trusted person for help.

questions.second_wrong_explanation: Safe decisions use evidence from the situation and appropriate help when needed.
questions.correct_feedback: Safe decisions use evidence from the situation and appropriate help when needed.

questions.prompt: What should happen after the learner answers the situation questions?

options.text: Apply the healthy action in the game world and observe the result.
Collect the symbol without helping the NPC or area.

Upload the static question text to the server.

questions.second_wrong_explanation: The correct choice must be applied in the world so the learner sees its effect.
questions.correct_feedback: The correct choice must be applied in the world so the learner sees its effect.

areas.world_action: Apply a safe, age-appropriate action demonstrating Leading rhythmic activities and dances.
areas.world_result: The NPC or environment in Warm-Up Circle visibly improves after the healthy action.
